title: eap_pl
text: eap_pl provides the shared Polars calculations used in Empirical Asset Pricing with Polars. The function reference lists the expected columns, return units, and output for each helper.

title: eap_pl
text:
Installation
From the book checkout, uv sync installs the local package in the book environment. To install just the package into another environment, run this command from the checkout with that environment’s Python.
python -m pip install ./packages/eap_pl

title: eap_pl
text:
Example
Compute cross-sectional correlations within each month. Pearson uses the 0.5th and 99.5th percentile cutoffs, and Spearman uses ranks of the original values.
from datetime import date

import polars as pl

from eap_pl import period_correlations

stocks = pl.DataFrame({
    "month": [date(2012, 1, 1)] * 4 + [date(2012, 2, 1)] * 4,
    "beta": [0.6, 0.8, 1.1, 1.4, 0.5, 0.9, 1.0, 1.3],
    "size": [20.0, 55.0, 40.0, 120.0, 100.0, 50.0, 80.0, 30.0],
})
period_correlations(stocks, ["beta", "size"], "month").sort("month")
The data-loading helpers read the local Parquet repository configured in DATA_DIR. See Preliminaries in the book for the required WRDS tables and derived files.
